Since the query "when did dragon ball z air" is broad, the answer must specify the different premieres and timeframes for Japan, the United States, and other broadcasts, as supported by the various documents.

Dragon Ball Z originally aired in Japan from April 26, 1989, to January 31, 1996 [d3, d4, d6]. In the United States, the English-dubbed series first premiered on September 13, 1996 [d5, d6, d7]. The series also aired in other regions later, such as in the United Kingdom in Fall 1998 [d1]. A remastered version titled Dragon Ball Z Kai premiered in Japan on April 5, 2009 [d1].
